fields.title: National research portal record
fields.description: Every record carries _input, _source, _scrapedAt, recordType, portal and portalName. recordType discriminates the payload: ARTICLE (a paper from any of the three portals, mapped onto one vocabulary), JOURNAL (Garuda journal directory), AUTHOR (Garuda researcher directory), SOURCE (reference mode) and ERROR. Portal-specific extras stay under _raw.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The query that produced this record.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was emitted.

portalName.title: Portal name
portalName.description: Full name of the national portal the record came from.

title.title: Title
title.description: Title of the paper or journal, in the language it was published in.

url.title: URL
url.description: Public page for this record on its portal.

documentId.title: Document ID
documentId.description: The portal's own identifier for the paper.

authors.title: Authors
authors.description: List of {name, authorId}. Garuda gives its internal author ID, KCI gives the author's ORCID where they registered one.

authorNames.title: Authors (joined)
authorNames.description: Author names joined with '; ', for spreadsheets.

source.title: Published in
source.description: Journal, proceedings or series the paper appeared in, including volume and issue where the portal prints them together.

publicationDate.title: Publication date
publicationDate.description: Fuller date where the portal publishes one, e.g. 2026-09.

citationCount.title: Citations
citationCount.description: How many times KCI records the paper as cited.

indexTier.title: Index tier
indexTier.description: KCI's indexing tier for the journal, e.g. accredited or candidate.

doi.title: DOI
doi.description: Digital Object Identifier where the portal publishes one.

description.title: Description
description.description: Abstract or summary line where the portal publishes one.

downloadUrl.title: Full-text download
downloadUrl.description: Direct link to the publisher's PDF, when the portal links one (Garuda).

sourceUrl.title: Original source
sourceUrl.description: Link to the article on the publisher's own site (Garuda).

dataUrl.title: Machine-readable record
dataUrl.description: JSON representation of the record on the portal (CiNii).

coverImageUrl.title: Cover image
coverImageUrl.description: Journal cover image published by the portal.

affiliation.title: Affiliation
affiliation.description: Institution the researcher is registered under.

documentCount.title: Documents
documentCount.description: How many documents the portal attributes to the researcher.

page.title: Result page
page.description: Which page of results this record came from.

totalResults.title: Total results
totalResults.description: How many records the portal says match the query in total.

isAvailable.title: Available
isAvailable.description: Whether the portal answered with usable data (reference mode).

sample.title: Sample
sample.description: Evidence measured during the probe, including which modes that portal supports.

_raw.title: Raw published values
_raw.description: The portal's own row or object, kept because these run-on citation strings change format without notice.

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Human-readable detail, naming the portals that do support the request where relevant.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across every record type.

articles.title: Articles
articles.description: Papers across all three portals in one vocabulary.
